title: Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds
main_claim: Let X be a smooth rationally connected projective manifold with T_X = E_1 ⊕ E_2, both of positive rank. Then both summands are integrable, which proves Höring's conjecture in the smooth RC case. Höring's Theorem 1.4 [Hor07] then gives a compatible product decomposition X ≅ X_1 × X_2.
coverage:
I read every section: the introduction, boxes, transport, vanishing, consequences, and both appendices (variation and surface). The checks below are by hand; I did not run any code.
(1) Formal Cauchy problem (Lemma formal). I checked that ∂_v F = P_2 ∂_u F is equivalent to the pair of tangency conditions, and I re-derived the source coordinate change ∂_{u'} = a∂_u + (b−a)∂_v, ∂_{v'} = b∂_v.
(2) Rational reconstruction. The conormal bundle of the diagonal Δ is O(−2), so the graded pieces sit in O(d+2m−2k). I confirmed that the sum of their dimensions is (m+q+1)^2 for d = 2q, which is smaller than 2(m+1)^2 for large m. The cancellation step that makes the ratios holomorphic near a point is valid.
(3) Removal lemma. After canceling r^{α−1}, evaluating on a vector tangent to the exceptional curve H gives P_1 dF'(w) = 0 and P_2 dF'(w) = 0, so F' is constant on every exceptional curve.
(4) Transport. The projected-bracket partial connection is tensorial in the E_j direction and satisfies Leibniz in the E_i argument. On each P^1 fiber it gives a holomorphic connection, which is flat, so the bundle is trivial along fibers and F^*E_i ≅ pr_i^*(g^*E_i).
(5) Vanishing argument. On L_i the complementary bundle is trivial, so the bracket section is constant. It vanishes at a and therefore at b, where both transports are the identity. The orientation of L_i and the indices are consistent.
(6) Two-point family. Submersivity of the two-point evaluation is obtained by a countable-family plus measure-zero argument; it is the standard very-free-curve fact.
Sanity check: on Höring's A × P^1 example the tangent box exists, and there are no sections of g^*E_1 vanishing at a, so the example does not contradict the argument.
